people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
translations.bsb: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.
translations.kjv: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
translations.asv: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
